metaDescription: Marketing CRM. Closed-loop ads → contract → ROAS. Built for real estate, agencies, and F&B.

hero.subtitle: See which ads become contracts. CPL, ROAS, SLA — one system, built around your industry.

trust: For teams that run real ads — not a contact notebook.

position.title: Not a contact CRM. Not an HR suite.
position.lead: Marketing buyers decide on one question: which ads become contracts?

rows.title: Closed-loop
rows.body: Meta and Google spend land on the same lead and contract. AMs stop exporting spreadsheets to explain ROAS.

rows.title: By industry
rows.body: Real estate closes bookings. Agencies close per-client ROAS. F&B closes reservations. No generic pipeline for all three.

rows.title: Agency OS
rows.body: Many clients, one portal, one SLA. Each client sees only their numbers.

modules.title: Four modules. Not an ERP.
modules.lead: Enough to turn marketing into revenue.

items.title: Leads & care
items.body: Pipeline, SLA, one source of truth.

items.title: Real estate
items.body: Leads by project. Metric: lead → booking, CPL by channel. Industry plan.

items.title: Agency
items.body: Per-client ROAS on the portal. Handoff SLA has an owner. Agency OS.

items.title: F&B
items.body: Campaign to reservation / store. One CRM for the chain. Industry plan.

steps.title: Sold through demo. No public self-serve trial.
steps.lead: A 14-day sandbox opens only after a qualified demo.

items.title: Request
items.body: A two-minute form. Sales in business hours.
